adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, which does `Readability::Document.new(open(url).read, ...)` with no `rescue` or HTTP/status handling (app/models/topic_embed.rb). This method is now used directly in `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` inside the `parser.threads.each` loop (`post = TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], ...)`), so an `OpenURI::HTTPError`, timeout, DNS failure, etc. would raise and abort the Thor task mid-import, leaving a partial migration. It’s also used from `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` (lib/topic_retriever.rb) invoked by `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` (app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb) with no error handling, so the job can fail and never create the embed; the controller renders `loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb) and the loading view reloads every 30s (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb), which can loop indefinitely if the job keeps failing. This behavior is directly implied by the new code paths in the diff.
